summary: group[i] selects the i-th host from 0, and negative indexes count from the end, so webservers[0] is the first and webservers[-1] the last.
questions: How do I target the first host of a group?
How do I target the last host in a group?

answer_card.title: Select a host by index
answer_card.answer_md: Zero-based: `webservers[0]` is the first host (`cobweb`). Negative counts from the end: `webservers[-1]` is the last (`weber`).
